title: query ancestors
summary: Resolves the transitive class/interface hierarchy of a type
intro: Read this to see everything a class or interface descends from, or to check whether it descends from one specific ancestor. The answer comes straight from the index.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Inspect Symbol > Ancestors of Type (full chain)...
steps: Needs an index of the project
drag-lint > Inspect Symbol > Ancestors of Type (full chain)...
Enter the type; its ancestor chain is listed

questions.ask: What is the full ancestor chain of this class?
Does it descend from a given ancestor?
